# Images

Devcontainer-based Docker images published from this repo to GHCR and registered
as public disk images on [GitHub Sandbox](https://github.com/github/sandbox).
Each image is built by the `publish-cca-*-image.yml` workflows in
`.github/workflows/` and pushed to `ghcr.io/github/sweagentd/<image-name>`.

## Images

### `cca/`

Base image for the [Copilot Coding Agent](https://github.com/github/copilot-coding-agent),
intended for sandboxes that execute the **stable** [Copilot CLI](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli).
Published as `ghcr.io/github/sweagentd/copilot-cca` and registered with the
Sandbox API under the name `cca`.

The Copilot CLI itself is layered on at build time via the
`ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/copilot-cli` devcontainer feature
(see `devcontainer.json`).

### `cca/` (prerelease variant)

Same base `Dockerfile` as `cca/` above, but built with
`devcontainer.prerelease.json`, which pins the Copilot CLI devcontainer feature
to the **prerelease** channel. Used by CCA sandboxes that need to exercise
unreleased Copilot CLI behavior ahead of GA.

Published as `ghcr.io/github/sweagentd/copilot-cca-prerelease` and registered
with the Sandbox API under the name `cca-prerelease`.

### `cca-runtime/`

Base image for CCA sandboxes that run the **CCAv3 entrypoint** (the
[`copilot-agent-runtime`](https://github.com/github/copilot-agent-runtime)
runtime that handles steering, progress reporting, commit/push, GPG signing,
and PR description generation, mirroring CCA's behavior when it runs on
Actions). The CCAv3 tarball is generated by the publish workflow and extracted
into `/opt/copilot-runtime` inside the image. The workflow builds the tarball
from the commit pinned by the `runtime` submodule so the sandbox image matches
the runtime version used by the Actions image build. This image is updated on
changes to the submodule, merged to `main`.

Published as `ghcr.io/github/sweagentd/copilot-cca-runtime` and registered with
the Sandbox API under the name `cca-runtime`.
